findings.explanation: The authorization check allows bypassing the 'admin' role requirement if the 'X-Internal-Debug' header is set to '1'. This is an incorrect authorization logic (CWE-863) that allows any authenticated user to access sensitive data (all users and orders) by manipulating a client-controlled header.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the header-based bypass. Enforce strict role-based access control: `if user.role != "admin": return jsonify({"error": "forbidden"}), 403`.
